description: This file contains unit tests for the SingleComparisonNode class, which is part of a predicate AST in the Eclipse Ditto RQL model. It verifies behaviors such as equality, constructor argument validation, and visitor pattern interaction.

classes.name: SingleComparisonNodeTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for SingleComparisonNode, testing equality, constructor validation, and visitor pattern.

methods.name: hashcodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that SingleComparisonNode correctly implements equals and hashCode methods using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: typeConstructorWithNullAsFilterProperty
methods.description: Tests that constructing SingleComparisonNode with null property throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: typeConstructorSuccess
methods.description: Tests successful creation of SingleComparisonNode and verifies its properties.

methods.name: typeConstructorWithNullAsValue
methods.description: Tests that SingleComparisonNode can have a null value property.

methods.name: visitorGetsVisited
methods.description: Verifies that the accept method correctly calls the visit method on the PredicateVisitor.
